tools: Gradle 7.6.4 (downloaded by the commands from services.gradle.org, sha256 checked)
commands: [ -x gradle-7.6.4/bin/gradle ] || { curl -fsSL -o gradle-7.6.4-bin.zip https://services.gradle.org/distributions/gradle-7.6.4-bin.zip && python3 -c "import hashlib,sys; sys.exit(hashlib.sha256(open('gradle-7.6.4-bin.zip','rb').read()).hexdigest() != 'bed1da33cca0f557ab13691c77f38bb67388119e4794d113e051039b80af9bb1')" && unzip -qo gradle-7.6.4-bin.zip; }
notes: Commit = tag r1rv77 (release 1.77). The tag has gradlew but no gradle/wrapper/ directory, so the wrapper cannot run; the project's CI (ci/test_17.sh) runs an installed Gradle 7 on JDK 17, hence Gradle 7.6.4 from services.gradle.org, with GRADLE_USER_HOME in the work directory so no user-level Gradle configuration takes part. Only :prov:jar (and :core, which it depends on; core's classes are inside the prov jar), tests not run; --max-workers and the heap are resource flags. The Gradle build names the jar 1.75 (gradle.properties version=1.75; 1.77 is only in bc-build.properties, used by the ant release scripts), so the lib file is bcprov-jdk18on-1.75.jar although the sources are release 1.77. JDK >= 9 selects vmrange jdk18on with source/target 1.8 (class files major 52). Compared with the Central 1.77 jar, the Gradle jar also has 42 legacy NTRU classes (org/bouncycastle/pqc/legacy/{crypto,math}/ntru) and lacks the multi-release META-INF/versions classes, signature files and core's resources; none of these is on the harness path (org.bouncycastle.math.ec.rfc8032.Ed25519). Fixed: bcprov-jdk18on 1.78.
